lines.en: Pain flared in my cheek several times, as though it were being burned.
“Kim Dokja! Hey! What's going on?!”
My vision flickered, and my consciousness slowly rose to the surface.
[The exclusive skill, ‘Fourth Wall’, is active at high intensity!]
My voice didn't sound like my own.

It felt as though, for the briefest moment, I had become an entirely different being and come back. That chilling sensation still lingered throughout my body. My shoulder flinched beneath Jang Hayoung's fingertips.
“What happened to you?”
My memory of what had happened was unclear.
I remembered checking my Attributes Window after asking the [Fourth Wall], but after that I had heard a voice······.
Rubbing my temples, I asked.
“······How long was I out?”
“I don't know! I came running when lightning suddenly struck!”
“Lightning?”
“You know those sparks you get when you violate probability? Those······.”
“They struck like lightning?”
Jang Hayoung nodded vigorously.
“I've never seen any that big!”
Looking more closely, I saw that my clothes, including my coat, were charred black. The backlash had been powerful enough to damage even a coat with an automatic repair function this badly······.
There was even a gaping hole in the office ceiling, as though a meteorite had struck it.
“Are you okay?”
“I'm fine. More than fine, actually······.”
If anything, I felt lighter.
That should have been impossible.
My incarnation body was burned this badly, yet my mind was so clear.
Even my Story power felt more abundant.
[Your comprehension increases through the effects of the exclusive skill, ‘Reading Comprehension’.]
The moment I saw that message, my earlier memories returned.
Right.
I had definitely seen that message.
[Your understanding of the character ‘Kim Dokja’ has increased.]
The message had labeled me a ‘character’.
That had never happened before.
A chill brushed through a corner of my heart.
I had seen beings undergo the process of ‘becoming a character’ a few times before. People who had come from outside the ‘original work’, only to become assimilated into it.
It had mostly happened to those called ‘readers who dropped the novel’.
I hurriedly tried to summon my Attributes Window.
‘Attributes Window.’
But the Attributes Window didn't open.
The reason was obvious.
[The ‘Fourth Wall’ is glaring at you.]
I broke into a cold sweat.
「Kim Dok ja looked for 15 sec onds」
‘I'm sorry. Really.’
How was I supposed to know that much time had passed?
Honestly, whether it was 10 seconds or 15, it was barely enough time to examine a single Attributes Window.
「Won't show you any mo re」
‘Wait. Let me ask just one thing.’
I hurriedly caught hold of the [Fourth Wall] as it was about to disappear.
‘What exactly is behind that [Wall]?’
My memory was hazy, but I had definitely seen something right before passing out.
Probing a little further, I thought I might even have briefly spoken with someone.
There had definitely been several shadows there.
「······Slee py.」
With those words, the [Fourth Wall] fell asleep.
Its functions were still working, but its consciousness seemed to have switched off.
Damn it.
[You have acquired a new Story!]
[You have acquired the Story, ‘Looked into the Abyss’.]
[This Story has no grade indicated.]
I stared blankly at the messages flickering in midair.
Looked into the Abyss.
I already knew the being who acquired that Story in the original work.
That was why I couldn't stop the goosebumps rising along my spine.
Questions broke free of their reins and ran wild through my head.
Why had I acquired this ‘Story’ here?
What connection was there between that ‘Story’ and my being labeled a ‘character’?
Had I become a ‘character’ now, or was I still a ‘reader’?
Was I still someone who could change the future?
“Kim Dokja?”
Jang Hayoung was looking at me, emotions plainly visible in those eyes.
How nice it would be if my situation were as clear as those eyes. If I could read things about myself as easily as I could read that gaze······.
At that moment, a spark flashed in my head.
「What would happen if I used [Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint] on myself?」
I had never considered that before.
There was definitely something hidden inside me that even I didn't know about.
I didn't know whether the author had left it there, or whether it had naturally seeped into me as the world changed. What was certain was that I needed to find out what it was, even if it took time.
But once I actually resolved to use [Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint], I hesitated.
······Would using it tell me what kind of being I was?
After all, [Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint] was a skill whose only functions were reading another person's thoughts and movements, or inhabiting that person's viewpoint······.
[······Kim Dokja? Are you okay?]
I only managed to pull myself out of that mire of thought after noticing the dokkaebi floating before my eyes.
“Bihyung?”
I stared at Bihyung with a stupid look on my face.
Hadn't this bastard said he was leaving earlier?
Bihyung hesitated and stammered.
[Ah······ there was a sudden backlash, so······.]
He had said he was busy, but apparently he'd actually been watching from nearby.
What an utterly sneaky bastard.
How could I trust him when he did things like this?
[D-don't get the wrong idea. I came back because I forgot to tell you something.]

As I casually chatted with a dokkaebi who was a new face to Jang Hayoung, Hayoung stood beside me, staring our way with wide, startled eyes. I patted Hayoung's shoulder to signal that everything was fine, then asked Bihyung.
“What didn't you tell me?”
[As you probably know, this ‘Demon King Selection’ event is going to get very big.]
I had already expected that.
After all, I had blown the lid off the story already circulating in secret among the constellations when I visited the ‘Gourmet Association’.
Some of the bastards who had been there would definitely take part in the ‘Demon King Selection’ too.
[The thing is, it's not just getting bigger. A fight has broken out over the broadcasting rights. As you probably expected, I'm not the only one dispatched to the ‘Demon Realm’.]
“Then?”
[There's a dokkaebi you know on the other side.]
A dokkaebi I knew?
[Someone with a massive grudge against you and me.]
There were about two dokkaebis like that.
But one was in Murim, so that left only one.
[Yeah.]
Dokgak. That dokkaebi, who had been in charge of the Japanese channel, had once suffered badly at Bihyung's hands and mine.
We had been lucky then, but there was no guarantee we would be now.
Even among the dokkaebis in ‘Ways of Survival’, Dokgak had an exceptional talent for running channels.
If he had been chosen as one of the dokkaebis leading this ‘Demon King Selection’, things would certainly not go smoothly from here.
[So, well, anyway, watch yourself. Take good care of your channel too······ Wait. What happened to your dokkaebi?]
“My dokkaebi?”
Come to think of it, I'd been feeling very lonely for a while.
Through the hole in the ceiling, I could see the constellations fixed in the sky, twinkling diligently.
It was strange. Even if I had ordered the channel blocked, I should still have heard their complaints······ Yet not a single message was reaching my ears.
“Biyoo?”
Uneasy, I tried calling her name aloud.
Biyoo didn't appear. At first, I thought she must be asleep again, but one minute passed, then two, and she still didn't appear.
A dreadful premonition seized me.
······Surely not?
“Biyoo!”
Biyoo had disappeared.
[You have entered channel #BI-7623!]
[The constellation, ‘Bald General of Justice’, is deeply moved by your return.]
[The constellation, ‘Maritime War God’, gives you a welcoming smile.]
[Many constellations welcome your return!]
As I entered Bihyung's channel, names I hadn't seen in some time welcomed me.
But even amid that barrage of cheers, I couldn't feel the slightest joy.
[The constellation, ‘Demon King of Salvation’, asks about the whereabouts of the dokkaebi ‘Biyoo’.]
Several constellations immediately answered.
[The constellation, ‘Bald General of Justice’, wipes his head as though troubled.]
[The constellation, ‘King Heungmu the Great’, clears his throat and brings his thumb and forefinger together.]
[Some constellations say they would be willing to answer if you gave them coins.]
······Come to think of it, our Korean Peninsula constellations didn't have much money.
As I rummaged through my pocket for coins, Jang Hayoung spoke.
“Could she have been caught in the backlash?”

Since Biyoo wasn't affiliated with the [Bureau], she had no [Giant Story] to protect her when a powerful backlash struck. So I couldn't rule out the possibility that she had been swept up in it and died. But.
“I don't think so. There are no traces.”
If that had happened, gruesome fragments would have been scattered around, but there was no trace of Biyoo anywhere.
It felt as though someone had torn away the entire being called ‘Biyoo’.
Who could it be? Who on earth had taken Biyoo······.
At that moment, Bihyung, who had been gnawing on his nails, raised his head.
The moment our eyes met, we realized we were thinking the same thing.
Biyoo was the only dokkaebi in the Demon Realm with an independent channel.
[Damn it. Those bastards did this.]
“The Wenny men.”
Sentences from the original work raced through my head.
「The only scenario region outside the jurisdiction of the ‘dokkaebis’. That is the ‘Demon Realm’.」

As written in the original ‘Ways of Survival’, the ‘Demon Realm’ was originally the Wenny men's territory. And in that territory, a dokkaebi unaffiliated with the [Bureau] had been found to possess a private channel.
―That soul is ours.
The first Wenny man I had met had also coveted the ‘dokkaebi egg’.
In the Demon Realm as it stood now, the value of an independent channel was incalculable.
A [Giant Story] event, happening in the Demon Realm for the first time in ages. There was no way the Wenny men would miss an event unfolding within their sphere of influence.
They must have stolen the channel with this ‘Demon King Selection’ in mind.
Wenny men were also naturally highly resistant to ‘probability’. So even if the backlash had swept through the area while I was unconscious, they could still have pushed through it and taken Biyoo.
But damn it······ Why now, of all times?
[Leave it to me. I'll find them.]
I glanced back at Bihyung. His eyes were filled with anger.
[Dokkaebi honor is at stake. Even if she's not affiliated with the ‘Bureau’, I can't stand by and watch.]
“Let's go together.”
But Bihyung shook his head.
[There isn't much time left until the ‘Demon King Selection’. You've got things you need to do before then, don't you?]
He was right. There was very little time left now.
If I mismanaged my time while searching for Biyoo, I might be defeated the moment the selection began.
“······Why are you going this far for me?”
[You're in my channel right now.]
Bihyung spoke while avoiding my gaze.
[I'm only doing this for my channel. Just focus on figuring out how to win. That'll make the constellations happy, and my channel will grow too.]
With those words, Bihyung vanished from the air.
Jang Hayoung asked.
“······Is it really okay to trust him?”
Few questions were as foolish as whether or not to trust a dokkaebi.
My trust in Bihyung aside, you could search the entire <Star Stream> and find few species as inscrutable as dokkaebis.
I let out a short sigh.
It wasn't a good time to bother Yoo Joonghyuk, and Jang Hayoung wasn't skilled enough to pursue Bihyung.
Ultimately, anyone likely to grant my request would be up in that night sky. The problem was that I was currently in Bihyung's channel.
In other words, any message I sent through the channel would inevitably pass through Bihyung, where he could read it.
In that case······ there was only one way.
“Jang Hayoung. Call up your ‘Wall’.”
Swift footsteps racing through the darkness.
[Baat, baaaat!]
Trapped inside a birdcage, Biyoo let out a heartbroken cry.
[Baaat! Baat······!]
A stooped old man with a small wen dangling from his left cheek was running down a dark road.
There was a spring in his hurried steps. The old man was in an exceedingly good mood.
[The age of dokkaebis is over now.]

The old Wenny man was excited at the thought of boasting of his achievement to the other Wenny men. Recently, one of his fellow Wenny men had brought back a ‘Story for beating dokkaebis’ and bragged endlessly about it. He had been terribly envious. But what he had brought back this time wasn't a Story for beating dokkaebis. It was an actual ‘dokkaebi’.
The old Wenny man stroked Biyoo's cage affectionately.
[Child, you will become the first ‘Wenny man’ to possess a channel.]
The Wenny men's long-held wish.
To reclaim the control over stories that the ‘dokkaebis’ had stolen from them.
[The storyteller of ■■. Who will free the slaves from this terrible hell of scenarios······.]
The wen on the old Wenny man's left cheek swelled enormously.

The excited old man's wen writhed, tapping against the cage containing Biyoo. Staring at the wen with terrified eyes, Biyoo hurriedly looked around. She desperately searched for someone to save her, but sadly, there was no person here who could.
[Hey.]
To be precise, it was only ‘people’ who were absent.
[Are you going to move that wen or not?]
The moment the Wenny man turned around, three spears made of bright yellow sparks struck the ground directly in front of him.
Tsssssss!
The Wenny man frowned and stepped back.
The attack clearly carried the power of a [Giant Story].
[An advanced dokkaebi?]
Beyond the yellow trails coloring the air, a floating silhouette came into view.
A baby-sized dokkaebi wearing a neat straw cloak.
It was Bihyung.
[Put the kid down and fuck off while I'm still asking nicely.]
Scarlet fangs flashed inside Bihyung's snarling mouth.
The dokkaebis of the <Star Stream> rarely became angry.
The constellations in their channels didn't like dokkaebis displaying emotion. But even dokkaebis sometimes became truly angry.
When they bared their fangs like this, that was one of those times.
[This dokkaebi isn't even affiliated with the ‘Bureau’. Why are you interfering?]
[A dokkaebi is a dokkaebi.]
[How ridiculous.]
[······I gave birth to her. Even if I can't raise her, shouldn't I do my duty as a parent?]
At those words, the Wenny man burst into loud laughter.
[A parent? A parent, you say!]
He laughed so hard that the wen dangling from his cheek swung back and forth.
[Since when did dokkaebis have such a human side······? If you had one, why didn't you show it to my ancestors?]
[Sorry, but I wasn't even born back then.]
[Then who will compensate us for the suffering we endured?]
The Wenny man's eye, previously hidden beneath an eyepatch, was revealed. It was the [Great Demon's Eyes]. Its yellow iris spun round and round, beginning to exude a murderous presence.
[Who, I ask, will compensate us for the pain of having our ‘bag of stories’ stolen by you bastards?]
[What the hell are you talking about? I know that Story too. We returned the ‘bag of stories’, didn't we? Twice as much, even―]
Tssssss!
As the situation took a turn for the worse, Bihyung's expression began to stiffen.
He hadn't imagined the Wenny man would actually try to fight him.
He had made a bold entrance, but in truth, this was his first time fighting a Wenny man too.
―Whatever happens, avoid fighting Wenny men.
That was one of the warnings left by earlier generations of dokkaebis.
Bihyung was fairly old by the standards of the Seoul branch, but even he knew almost nothing about how the relationship between Wenny men and dokkaebis had begun.
All he knew for certain was that the two species had been at odds since some time before the concept of ‘channels’ was properly established.
The Wenny man spoke.
[It seems you know nothing. You never returned ‘what belonged to the Wenny men’.]
Bihyung snapped irritably.
[I don't know anything about that crap. Just hand over the kid! If you don't―]
[There are many kinds of evil in this world.]
An eerie chill laced the Wenny man's voice.
Before Bihyung could shout anything, the Wenny man continued.
The words sounded like the lyrics of an old song.
[The ‘first evil’ is the evil of making someone unhappy.]
The Wenny man's wen pouch was gradually growing larger.
Suddenly, an alarm rang out in Bihyung's head.
[The ‘second evil’ is the evil of taking pleasure in that unhappiness.]
With the lyrics, something was being released from the Wenny man's pouch.
‘Something’ that must never be released.
[The ‘most abhorrent evil’ is the evil of putting that unhappiness on display (展示) for others.]
Bihyung acted without hesitation.
[Using the authority of the Giant Story.]
When Bihyung became an advanced dokkaebi, some rights to the Giant Story had been transferred to him.
With this power to manipulate the <Star Stream>, even a Wenny man wouldn't be able to resist.
But the Wenny man was smiling.
[Didn't your predecessors tell you? Never use that power in front of a Wenny man.]
Tssssssss!
The pitch-black Story flowing from the wen began to bind the Stories throughout Bihyung's body.
All the language of the system was turning black.
As though someone were covering the world in black paint.
[The operation of the Giant Story is ■■■■······.]
Bihyung was startled.
Only the highest-ranking dokkaebis, Great Dokkaebis or above, were capable of this sort of manipulation.
Then how could a Wenny man possess such power······?
[Could it be······ the language of another world?]
[Foolish dokkaebi. Coming here alone was your mistake.]
Something was crawling out through the swollen wen pouch. A grotesque creature extended its tentacles through the ruptured wen.
【Guh. Guuh, guuuuut.】
Fshshsh!
The tentacles shot out, seizing Bihyung's small body in an instant.
[The Story, ‘Song of the Wenny Person’, takes effect.]
Looking at the Stories binding him, Bihyung belatedly understood.
Why the earlier generations of dokkaebis had told him to avoid Wenny men.
[Your resistance to ‘Wenny men’ drops sharply due to your species attribute.]
[The Wenny man's hatred weakens your mental fortitude.]
[The Wenny man's resentment causes your combat power to plummet.]
That helplessness, which he hadn't felt in so long, made Bihyung feel as though he had become an ‘incarnation’.
Countless gazes pouring down from the sky pierced his body like arrows.
[The constellation, ‘King Heungmu the Great’, is horrified by the Wenny man's power.]
[The constellation, ‘God of Wine and Ecstasy’, frowns at the source of the Wenny man's power.]
[The constellation, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’, clenches his fists.]
[The constellation, ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’, is greatly enraged!]
The Wenny man laughed.
[We cannot wield this power against other species. But dokkaebis are different.]
Squeeeeeze!
The tentacles pressed in like a juicer, slowly choking the breath out of Bihyung. Through their crushing grip, he could feel the Wenny men's deep resentment.

A Story that wielded near-invincible power against dokkaebis as long as certain special conditions were met. Bihyung was appalled by this Wenny man's Story, steeped from its very birth in hatred for a single species.
[Die beneath the voyeuristic gazes of those constellations you love so much. I'll acquire a very good Story today.]
Guuuuugh······.

Stories slowly dripped from Bihyung as he was squeezed like a piece of fruit. He belatedly contacted the [Bureau], but he would be dokkaebi juice before they arrived. Just as his consciousness began to fade beneath the tightening tentacles.
Shhk-shhk!
The tentacles wrapped around Bihyung burst, spilling pitch-black blood.
The startled Wenny man groaned and backed away, while Bihyung's freed little body fell toward the ground. A tall man caught Bihyung by his straw cloak.
“Facing a Wenny man in your true body. What a foolish dokkaebi.”

Bihyung turned his head at the man's cold voice. Bloodstained boots. The hem of a pitch-black long coat fluttered in the wind. Biyoo, trapped in her cage, cried out “Baaat,” and the constellations in the sky poured out indirect messages.
[The constellation, ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’, screams and cheers!]
Only when he saw the black saber in the man's hand did Bihyung realize who he was.
The moment his eyes met the man's, Bihyung felt goosebumps rise.

It wasn't because of the man's skill—the [Sage's Eye], designed by the oldest human in all the dimensions—nor was it because of the fierce killing intent rising from his entire body. Bihyung had met countless incarnations.
But this man was the only incarnation with eyes like these.
An expression as though he were weighing whether to kill Bihyung here.
As Bihyung snapped back to his senses and struggled, the man threw him backward.
“Get the hell back.”

With a whoosh, Bihyung landed far away and tumbled across the ground. Without a word, the man adjusted his grip on the sword in his right hand. As the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] cried out, a Status that had reached transcendence formed a solid Story and began to envelop him.
The severed tentacles writhed on the ground. Yoo Joonghyuk spoke to the Wenny man, who was staring blankly at the sight.
“Are you the ‘Demon of the Horizon’?”
[Indeed. It has been a while, puppet of the Oldest Dream.]
“······This is the first time I've seen you.”
[Hahaha! You will never know! Even if you suffer a thousand deaths and live another ten thousand lives, you will never know. Because you······!]
Whoooosh!

As though he had no intention of listening to the Wenny man's nonsense, Yoo Joonghyuk's sword cleaved through the air without hesitation. Watching the blade narrowly pass before his nose, the Wenny man cried out in alarm.
[Wouldn't it be best for us both to back down here? You have nothing to do with this affair―]
“Hand over Shin Yoosung.”
[What?]
Following Yoo Joonghyuk's gaze, he found the cage containing Biyoo. Realizing what was happening, the Wenny man ground his teeth and spoke.
[Were you after the dokkaebi too? Hmph! A human like you would have no use for a channel―]
“I don't need a channel.”
Ruuuuumble!
Biyoo's eyes trembled inside the cage.
Bihyung, who had fallen, got back up and listened to those words in a daze.
The Status of a transcendent rippled along Yoo Joonghyuk's unyielding blade.
The Wenny man gave a hollow laugh.

[How absurd. An ignorant whelp who doesn't even know this dokkaebi's value······ Do you know? Even you cannot manage it in this round. Even if that fellow named ‘Kim Dokja’ is present, it will make no difference! A variable of that magnitude cannot defy the flow of the <Star Stream>······.]
Kra-kra-kra-kra-boom!
Sparks of transcendence erupted, and Yoo Joonghyuk's [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] unleashed a waterfall of magic power. The Wenny man's blasted-off arm flew through the air.
As multicolored waves of magic power poured from the blade of [Splitting the Sky Energy], which had reached a new realm, the Wenny man turned deathly pale and cried out.
[S-stop! You've accumulated too few rounds to know yet. In other parallel dimensions······!]
Tssssss!
The excessive disclosure of information caused sparks of probability to begin flying around the Wenny man too. Hastily swallowing his words, he shouted again.
[In any case, you're making a mistake! You must never make an enemy of me―].
“I promised my companion. That I would take revenge for them.”
Biyoo trembled inside the cage.
Even though she should already have lost her memories, even though so much of her previous life should have disappeared, Biyoo's body was trembling violently.
“You will die here.”
Here and now, there was no Shin Yoosung with memories of the 41st round.
Then for whom was this revenge?
Even Yoo Joonghyuk did not know.
He simply swung his sword.
Just as he had taken revenge for the first round in the second, then revenge for the second round in the third.
He cut through the Wenny man's surging tentacles and inflicted a deep sword wound on one of his arms. The next moment, Yoo Joonghyuk was already standing behind him.
The towering blade of [Splitting the Sky Energy] swept forward, tearing through the entire space.
[W-wait! Sto―]
Shhk!
The Wenny man's wen, which had been so terrifying, flew through the air. The next moment, his body was engulfed in the darkness spilling out of it.
[I will curse you. I will curse you. The ‘me’ in every dimension will never forgive you······!]
The [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] plunged into the Wenny man's endlessly babbling mouth.
Guaaaaaaah.

With a horrific scream, the darkness released from the wen swallowed the Wenny man whole. The darkness let out a burp, as though it had eaten something delicious. It looked at Yoo Joonghyuk for a brief moment, then vanished completely from the Demon Realm.
And complete silence descended.
Perhaps because he had drawn too deeply on the power of transcendence, Yoo Joonghyuk stood still for a while, catching his breath. Countless system messages flooded his ears.
[You have acquired a new Legendary-grade Story!]
[You have achieved an unprecedented feat.]
[You have acquired the Story, ‘One Who Cut Off a Wenny Man’s Wen’!]
[All Wenny men in the Demon Realm have become hostile to you!]
Yoo Joonghyuk slowly walked over to the cage and carefully took Biyoo out.
Biyoo cried loudly.
Striking the back of Yoo Joonghyuk's hand over and over with her tiny hands.
Yoo Joonghyuk looked down at her for a moment, then quietly tucked her into his pocket and walked away.
[The constellation, ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’, grows teary-eyed.]
[The constellation, ‘Bald General of Justice’, offers the towel he was using to wipe his head.]
[The constellation, ‘Maritime War God’, is deeply moved and writes a poem.]

Countless constellations twinkled at him, but none of their light reached Yoo Joonghyuk. However long a constellation had lived, it could not understand a regressor who had experienced the world's destruction twice.
But when a message rang out the next moment, Yoo Joonghyuk raised his head.
[The constellation, ‘Demon King of Salvation’, looks at you.]
A star that had never appeared during his previous two rounds of life.
And yet, why was it?
Yoo Joonghyuk felt as though that star had been there for a very long time.
Yoo Joonghyuk spoke with a scowl.
“Get lost, Kim Dokja.”
And a star in the sky really did go out.
“...Kim Dokja?”
Kim Dokja gave no answer.
“Looks like that's more or less settled.”
I sighed as I watched Yoo Joonghyuk through the channel screen.
I had been anxious that the [Bureau] bastards might arrive first, but fortunately, Yoo Joonghyuk had been faster.
Sending Uriel a message through Jang Hayoung had been a good choice.
[The constellation, ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’, smiles brightly.]
Uriel was the one who had brought Yoo Joonghyuk there.
Yoo Joonghyuk was bound to be deeply upset with me over the ‘Breaking the Sky Sword Saint’ incident anyway. My judgment that Uriel's words would carry more weight with him than mine had paid off.
Looking at the limp Bihyung on the screen, Jang Hayoung spoke.
“I've never seen a dokkaebi that helpless.”
“It's because their species Stories are intertwined. To fight a Wenny man, you need at least a Great Dokkaebi or higher, or at least four dokkaebis attacking together.”
“······You know an awful lot, don't you? Aileen said everything about dokkaebis and Wenny men was shrouded in mystery.”
“For a constellation, this much is basic knowledge.”
At my words, Jang Hayoung looked at me with a curious respect.
Of course, not every constellation knew things like this.
The screen briefly showed a close-up of Biyoo crying and Yoo Joonghyuk cradling her.
「I will take revenge for you.」
「Goodbye, Captain.」
「You've been through a lot.」
「I'll leave the rest to you.」
「Rest.」
Sentences only I had been able to see flashed through my head.
Had those words now reached the place they were meant to go?
I couldn't really know, but I did know at least one thing.
At least those two now understood each other without such ‘words’.
Somewhere beyond what I, the reader, could read, they had unmistakably reached each other.
At that thought, I felt lonely for some reason.
“······Kim Dokja?”
Jang Hayoung's eyes, staring straight at me.
Feeling awkward, I scratched my head and hurriedly spoke.
“Anyway, Yoo Joonghyuk will handle things over there somehow, so we should get ready here······.”
Rrrrrumble!
······Damn it. Already?
Jang Hayoung and I looked out the office window at the same time.
Beyond the walls of the [Industrial Complex], a dense cloud of sand was rolling toward us.
Citizens murmuring.
I could also see Mark mobilizing the council members to calm them.
[Oh dear, we have some impatient constellations again. There are still a full 48 hours left until the ‘Demon King Selection’.]
A familiar dokkaebi's voice sounded from the air.
High above the industrial complex, ‘Dokgak’ was looking down at me and smiling.
[Originally, I intended to let things simmer a little longer······.]
His mouth was certainly smiling, but his eyes were filled with resentment toward me.
But however much he hated me, he couldn't simply start the ‘Demon King Selection’, with a [Giant Story] at stake, whenever he pleased.
[This time, starting early might not be such a bad idea.]
[You have received a new ‘sub-scenario’!]
[The sub-scenario ― ‘Skirmish’ is beginning!]
